title: Play’n Hooky Sportfishing
specs: Fish species include Pacific Blue Marlin, Black Marlin, Yellowfin Tuna (Ahi), Mahi Mahi, Striped Marlin, Spear Fish, Wahoo
Possible sightings of whales, dolphins, porpoises, monk seals, sea turtles, and seabirds
Fishing in waters from 1,200 to 9,000 feet deep near Oahu
On Private Charters you get to take home up to half the fish caught, up to 50 lbs. of fish.
Any single fish over 100 lbs. will not be cut, and will stay with the boat.
You may also bring alcohol (no glass containers, please), but we ask that you also bring just as much water to stay hydrated.
You may also bring alcohol (no glass containers, please), but we ask that you also bring just as much water and soda as well.

services.name: Private Charter - Full Day
services.desc: 8 Hours About Private Charters are just that, it’s your boat! You can go by yourself or take 5 of your friends. Because we fall under U.S. Coastguard regulations, we are allowed to have a maximum of 6 passengers on board. If you have additional anglers, NO PROBLEM, we can accommodate your group using additional boats. You can let the Captain know what type of fish you would like to target and the crew will try to accommodate, however, please keep in mind any fish can bite the hook! On Private Charters you get to take home up to half the fish caught, up to 50 lbs. of fish. If 10 Mahi Onboard Play N Hooky • Up to 6 Guests • 8 Hours

blurb: Guests board a 41' Hatteras Flybridge Sportfishing Vessel for deep sea fishing targeting species like Pacific Blue Marlin, Black Marlin, Yellowfin Tuna, Mahi Mahi, and others. Trips depart from Kewalo Harbor and fish in waters from 1,200 to 9,000 feet deep. The boat features air conditioning, a restroom, fridge, microwave, wifi, and TV for guest comfort.
